verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show Reclaim runs a live, first-party remote MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai. It is gated by the spec-compliant MCP OAuth flow and publishes discovery metadata with read/write/mcp scopes, so agents can plausibly connect to the account as a tool. However, no vendor documentation describes the server, and the evidence never shows which tools it exposes. missing for 10: documented tool list covering availability, bookings, and event types; first-party docs for the MCP server; independent hands-on corroboration of tool calls working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my scheduling account as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes availability, bookings, and event types

citations.quote: a live, auth-gated MCP endpoint on the vendor's own domain speaking the per-spec MCP OAuth flow
the server publishes its own OAuth discovery document with read/write/mcp scopes
